interview_note: My work shifts change every week, so my pay changes too. I want to know how much I can spend before Friday.
I get paid on different days each month. I never know if I can afford a weekend trip.
I forget bill dates even when I have the money. A reminder a few days early would help.
I paid a late fee twice last semester because I missed my phone bill.
I already use a spreadsheet. I would switch only if tracking takes less time.
I do not want a new app to connect to my bank account.
